data.long_meaning: The name Quentin is derived from the Latin name Quintus, which means 'fifth' in Roman numerals. In the Bible, Quentin is not a direct name, but it is associated with the fifth book of the Old Testament, which is called Quinquagesima in Latin. This name is popular among Christians due to its biblical connection and its meaning of being the fifth.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Quentin lies in its association with the biblical passage of Quinquagesima. This marks the beginning of Lent, a period of Christian observance leading up to Easter. As a name associated with the fifth book of the Old Testament, Quentin carries a reminder of the importance of the Lenten season and the faith journey that it represents. The name also highlights the idea of being the fifth, which can be interpreted as representing a call to be the fifth disciple, the fifth servant, or the fifth follower of Christ.
